WE ARE 
The Accenture LearnVantage Strategy & Operations (S&O) team serves as the growth engine of the Americas business. We design and execute go-to-market strategies that enable our sales teams, engage LearnVantage clients, and drive revenue across a diverse portfolio of subsidiary companies. We operate at the intersection of strategy, sales, and execution — and we are looking for exceptional business development leaders to help us support net new Accenture opportunities through channel-led motions.
 YOU ARE 
A high-impact Graphic & Visual Design Senior Analyst with a proven ability to translate business strategy into compelling visual narratives that drive engagement and action. You combine creative excellence with commercial awareness, understanding how visual storytelling can influence buying decisions, support go-to-market strategies, and differentiate LearnVantage offerings in a competitive landscape. With a sharp eye for detail and consistency, you ensure all outputs align to Accenture’s visual identity while pushing the boundaries to create memorable and impactful experiences. Operating with a momentum-driven, solution-oriented mindset, you thrive in fast-paced environments — leaning in, navigating ambiguity with confidence, and delivering high-quality work with speed and precision while collaborating cross-functionally to bring ideas to life with clarity, purpose, and impact.
 THE WORK 
Manage all graphics and art in proposal volumes associated with a strategic sales campaign.
Conceptualize selling messages within the context of proposal guidelines.
Simplifying and visualizing complex frameworks (e.g., learning journeys, ecosystem models, transformation pillars) into intuitive, easy-to-understand formats.
Maintain repository of all inbound, outbound, final, and draft graphics and art.
Maintain compliance within graphics requirements and internal or external controls.
Assist with electronic publishing for all required material, including requirements, status reports, and quality reviews.
 HERE'S WHAT YOU NEED 
2+ years of executing digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels (SEO, paid media, social, content marketing).
2+ years of content development and graphic design skills, with experience developing proposals, pursuit materials, and marketing assets that drive engagement.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (minimum 5 years) work experience.
 BONUS POINTS IF 
You have worked in a high velocity, fast-paced environment where iterating quickly based on feedback while maintaining attention to detail and brand integrity are equally important.
You have experience developing motion graphics, video storyboards, or multimedia assets (e.g., executive demos, sizzle reels) that enhance storytelling impact and audience engagement
You have a proven track record of partnering with marketing, sales, and leadership teams to elevate go-to-market materials that directly support deal origination and expansion opportunities
 Accenture LearnVantage — helping clients build the capability engine needed to thrive in an AI economy.

Job DescriptionJob Description
(On‑site – reports to the VP, Sales)


 About Clutch 


We're on a mission to reinvent the way people buy, sell, and own cars. 


Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning. Named to The Globe and Mail's list of Canada's Top Growing Companies for six consecutive years and also awarded spots on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team. Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and currently services Ontario, British Columbia, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including D1 Capital, Altos Ventures, BMO Capital Partners, Canaan, Real Ventures, and others. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.


 About the role 


We're looking for a smart, resourceful, and analytically strong individual to join our Revenue team as Strategy and Operations Manager (Revenue) . This role is an exceptional opportunity for someone early in their career (1–5 years post-grad) who's hungry to drive impact across a high-growth sales organization—working side by side with our VP of Sales on strategic initiatives, performance insights, and cross-functional projects that unlock growth.


 What You'll Do 


Project-Based Execution



 Lead and execute small to medium-sized strategic projects that drive incremental improvement across the sales team—ranging from process optimization to frontline tools to performance analysis.
 Take ownership of project scoping, planning, execution, and results measurement—working across disciplines to see initiatives through end-to-end.
 Ruthlessly prioritize initiatives that move the needle and align with broader revenue goals.


Work Cross-Functionally to Drive Change



 Collaborate with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Engineering to remove friction in the sales process and bring structure to ambiguity.
 Be equally comfortable building a business case in Excel, presenting findings to the VP Sales, or jumping into a call with a distressed customer to understand root causes.
 Translate complex problems into actionable insights—and ensure action happens.


Data-Driven Insights & Sales Strategy



 Dive deep into sales and funnel data to uncover insights and opportunities. You'll be expected to bring a strong analytical toolkit and be an 8+/10 when it comes to working with data.
 Support forecasting, territory planning, performance dashboards, and root cause analysis to inform sales leadership decision-making.
 Develop simple, clear, and persuasive recommendations backed by data and common sense.


Self-Learning & Experimentation



 Take initiative to self-learn new tools, frameworks, and strategies—whether it's mastering ChatGPT, learning how to write SQL, or figuring out how a new system works with minimal handholding.
 Be proactive in experimenting with new ideas, rapidly testing assumptions, and applying learnings in real-time.
 Develop comfort navigating ambiguity and unfamiliar territory—you'll regularly tackle challenges that don't come with a playbook.


 What We're Looking For 



 3+ years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, sales strategy, business operations, or a high-performing startup environment.
 8+/10 with data: Strong proficiency with Excel/Sheets required; experience with SQL, BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau)
 Proven ability to lead structured projects and think strategically, while also rolling up your sleeves to get things done.
 Comfortable with ambiguity and change—able to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.
 Intellectually curious, fast learner, and someone who brings strong judgment and common sense to every conversation.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills—you're just as comfortable with execs as you are with frontline staff or developers.
 Gritty, humble, and high-agency: you take initiative, own problems, and don't wait to be told what to do.


 Nice to Have 



 A genuine interest in Clutch's industry—automotive, marketplaces, consumer tech, or the future of retail.
 Passion for building things from the ground up and a desire to grow into a leadership role in the future.


 Why Clutch 



 Partner directly with the VP Sales on initiatives that materially impact top-line performance.
 Solve meaningful problems, fast: You'll be in the room where decisions happen and have the chance to influence direction across the business.
 Build your career: Whether your goal is GM, Product, Strategy, or Ops—this role sets a strong foundation for growth.
 Competitive package: Market cash, equity upside, full benefits, and a collaborative in-office culture built on pace and curiosity.


 Employment Type: 



 Existing, Permanent Full-Time


 Compensation & Benefits: 



 Salary range: $110k - $130k (plus equity)
 Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
 Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.


Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca .

 Our Purpose 
At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.
By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.
Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
 Summary 
We are seeking a Senior Consultant, Brand Strategy & Operations on 1 year fixed term to support complex brand operations, financial management, procurement, strategic planning, program management, and team enablement initiatives within a fast-paced marketing environment.
This role will serve as a self-directed operational and strategic partner to the Brand & Creative organization, ensuring that budgets, procurement processes, agency programs, team operations, reporting, and leadership priorities are executed accurately and efficiently. The successful candidate will work closely with Strategy & Operations leadership to manage large budgets, coordinate quarterly planning and reconciliation cycles, support agency governance programs, prepare executive-ready materials, and identify opportunities to improve existing operating processes.
The ideal candidate combines consulting fundamentals, strong financial acumen, advanced Excel capabilities, project/program management experience, exceptional attention to detail, and strong executive communication skills . You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously, working through complex budget and procurement processes, translating operational information into clear insights, and independently driving work from initial request through completion. 
Mandatory: Minimum 1 year of direct client-facing consulting experience , demonstrated strategy experience , strong executive communication/storytelling capabilities, and the ability to operate independently in complex, fast-paced environments in a recognized consulting or advisory environment .
 What will your typical day look like? 
As a Senior Consultant, Brand Strategy & Operations, you will support the day-to-day operating rhythm of a large Brand & Creative organization while partnering closely with Strategy & Operations leadership. Your day may include reviewing and reconciling budgets, maintaining detailed financial trackers, preparing spend requests and purchase approvals, monitoring contracts and POs, developing bottoms-up forecasts, or identifying risks against quarterly spend targets. 
You may also coordinate quarterly agency review programs, gather stakeholder feedback, develop executive-ready presentations, prepare materials for leadership meetings, and support team offsites and organizational planning. You will maintain accurate operational trackers, proactively identify upcoming priorities and resource requirements, and provide clear visibility into risks, dependencies, and financial status. You will also support AI-enabled team initiatives by maintaining use cases, monitoring savings and adoption, and communicating progress through leadership materials and recurring updates.
 About the team 
You will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative demand generation marketing team focused on driving awareness, engagement, and pipeline growth through integrated marketing initiatives. The team works closely with marketing, sales, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver scalable campaigns that generate measurable business impact. This environment values innovation, operational excellence, strategic thinking, and a data-driven approach to marketing performance.
 Enough about us, let’s talk about you 
 You are someone with these required skills, experience & qualifications: 
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, Operations, Marketing, Analytics, or a related discipline.
Typically 4–6 years of relevant professional experience, demonstrating strong Consultant/Senior Consultant-level ownership.
Minimum 1 year of genuine client-facing consulting experience within the consulting practice of a recognized consulting or advisory firm.
Strong experience in business operations, Strategy & Operations, financial operations, program management, or organizational enablement.
Demonstrated experience managing, tracking, forecasting, and reconciling large organizational or program budgets.
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including the ability to maintain detailed financial models, trackers, reconciliation files, forecasts, and reporting.
Experience supporting budget planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and quarterly or annual reconciliation cycles.
Experience working with procurement processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, contracts, spend approvals, suppliers, and/or vendors.
 It would be great for you to have some of these nice-to-haves as well: 
Experience at a recognized technology consulting, strategy consulting, or analytics advisory firm.
Experience supporting brand, creative, marketing, agency, or customer-facing organizations.
Experience managing agency/vendor governance programs, including performance reviews, feedback cycles, contracts, and commercial processes.
Experience with resource allocation, business cases, ROI analysis, or investment prioritization.
Experience creating or supporting organizational Rhythm of Business (RoB) processes.
Experience with advanced data analysis, financial modelling, or dashboarding.
Experience using AI-enabled productivity tools to improve workflows, automate recurring tasks, or enhance operational efficiency.
Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar enterprise solutions.
 Total Rewards 
The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $120,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.
Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.
 Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life. 
 Be yourself, and more. 
We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.
 You shape how we make impact. 
Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.
 Be the leader you want to be 
Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.
 Have as many careers as you want. 
We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.
 The next step is yours 
At Deloitte, we are all about doing business inclusively – that starts with having diverse colleagues of all abilities. Deloitte encourages applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of communities across Canada. This includes, but is not limited to, people with disabilities, candidates from Indigenous communities, and candidates from the Black community in support of living our values, creating a culture of Diversity Equity and Inclusion and our commitment to our AccessAbility Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and the BlackNorth Initiative.
We encourage you to connect with us at accessiblecareers@deloitte.ca if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations) or indigenouscareers@deloitte.ca for any questions relating to careers for Indigenous peoples at Deloitte (First Nations, Inuit, Métis).
When you apply, we will review your application using Deloitte's Global Talent Standards to ensure a consistent recruitment experience. Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

We acknowledge that Deloitte offices stand on traditional, treaty, and unceded territories in what is now known as Canada. We acknowledge this land is still home to many First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples, who continue to maintain their deep connection to the land and its sacred teachings. About the opportunity
The Senior Renewals Manager is an individual contributor role within the Revenue Operations organization, responsible for owning and executing the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers. This role is focused on retention, risk mitigation, and contractual accuracy, ensuring renewal outcomes align with both customer objectives and company revenue goals.
This individual plays a critical role in driving Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by ensuring timely renewals, protecting recurring revenue, and identifying expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.
Is This You?
You don’t wait for perfect processes—you move forward and figure it out. Ambiguity doesn’t slow you down; it’s where you do your best work. You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities shift, and you can pivot quickly without losing momentum.
You enjoy untangling complex problems, creating order out of chaos, and pushing systems and processes to evolve. You’re comfortable switching gears as needed—adapting your approach while staying focused on outcomes.
You collaborate effectively across teams, bring a strong analytical lens to your decisions, and maintain a clear customer focus—even as things change around you.
What you’ll get to do
Own the full customer-facing renewal lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic and enterprise accounts, from initiation through contract execution.
Partner closely with Account Executives to define and execute renewal strategies.
Create, prepare, and manage renewal contracts in collaboration with Finance and Legal, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and policy alignment.
Align renewal terms with customer objectives by working closely with Customer Success Managers and Sales leadership.
Proactively identify renewal risks and drive cross-functional mitigation strategies.
Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and pipeline data within CRM and renewal management systems.
Serve as a key liaison between customer-facing teams and internal operational stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
Support pricing strategy and contract structuring within defined guidelines.
Skills and experience we value
5–8+ years of experience in SaaS, technology, or enterprise software in renewals, revenue operations, customer success, or account management.
Proven track record managing complex renewals, including contract creation, negotiation support, and forecasting.
Strong understanding of Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and key drivers of recurring revenue.
Experience identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities while maintaining focus on renewal execution.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Proficiency with CRM and contract management tools (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ or RCA, Gong, DocuSign CLM, or similar).
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, trends, and performance metrics.
Strategic thinking with the ability to structure and optimize renewal deals.
What would make you stand out
Experience working with global enterprise accounts or complex, multi-entity deals.
Experience in regulated industries or public sector renewals.
Background in deal desk, pricing strategy, or advanced contract management.

With the UK operation expanding and a new warehouse in the pipeline, we're looking for someone who wants to be right at the heart of making things happen. Working directly with the COO, you'll have exposure to multiple areas of the business, take ownership of a varied workload and help turn plans into reality. No day will be the same, you'll be planning, organising and keeping projects moving while tackling unexpected challenges, finding solutions and getting stuck into something completely new.
 We're looking for someone who thrives on variety, takes initiative and enjoys making things happen . Someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do, isn't fazed by change and sees an opportunity where others see a problem.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business operations: Working closely with the COO to keep the day-to-day running of the UK business organised and on track.
 Planning and organisation: Taking responsibility for diaries, meetings, travel arrangements and schedules.
 Project delivery: Helping drive customer and internal projects forward, tracking progress, managing actions and keeping everyone aligned.
 Process improvement: Spotting inefficiencies, suggesting better ways of working and helping implement practical solutions.
 Team growth: Coordinating the onboarding of new employees and helping put the right structures in place as the team expands.
 Warehouse development: Playing an active role in preparing for the launch and ongoing operation of the new UK warehouse.
 External relationships: Building effective working relationships with customers, suppliers, contractors and other business partners.
 Getting things done: Taking on new challenges and providing hands-on support across the business as priorities evolve.

This is a role for someone who wants to be involved, not someone who wants to sit on the sidelines.
 You'll have a background in operations, project coordination, business support or a similar role. More importantly, you'll have the drive, confidence and common sense to operate in an environment where things are evolving quickly.
 Ideally, you'll have: 
At least two years' relevant experience in operations, project support, business administration or a similar position.
A degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience working in a growing business, start-up or scale-up environment would be advantageous.
Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office and Excel.
Experience juggling projects, coordinating activities and working with multiple stakeholders.
Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
Confident written and verbal communication skills.
A practical, solutions-focused approach to getting things done.

Enjoys solving problems rather than passing them on.

Can adapt quickly when priorities change.

 Job Description: 
Datasite Enterprise helps dealmakers manage complex, high-stakes transactions with secure, purpose-built technology and expert support. Our solutions streamline collaboration, improve visibility, and help teams move deals forward with confidence. The Sales Enablement Specialist is a key driver of seller performance and productivity across the EMEA region. In this role, you'll accelerate new-hire ramp time, strengthen ongoing seller capability, and equip our Sales teams with the training, tools, and processes they need to consistently meet and exceed targets. You'll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product, Service, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact enablement programs that directly influence revenue outcomes in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

Lead new seller onboarding to reduce ramp time and ensure proficiency in product knowledge, messaging, value proposition, competitive positioning, and the full sales process.

Coach sellers individually and in groups to reinforce best practices, sharpen skills, and drive continuous performance improvement. 
Partner with sales leadership and cross-functional teams and evaluate performance data to identify training needs, develop assessments, and align enablement programs to business priorities. 
Evaluate and recommend emerging tools, methodologies, and technologies that enhance sales effectiveness and productivity. 
Identify and drive process improvements to increase seller efficiency and maximise time spent in the field. 
Support regional and global enablement programs while serving as a trusted subject matter expert on Datasite’s products and services.

Bachelor’s Degree in Business or related field

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

**The Company**
Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.
When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.
AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.
This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.
**The Role**
The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.
This role owns critical components of revenue operations, including sales compensation execution, performance analytics, and executive reporting. In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.
As a key contributor to strategic planning and revenue optimization, this individual plays a central role in enabling predictable, scalable growth while continuously evolving reporting frameworks, compensation programs, and operational processes.
**What You Do**
**Sales Compensation Ownership & Strategy**
* Own the build and end-to-end administration of sales compensation programs, including plan implementation, maintenance, and commission calculations.
* Test new plans and changes before release. Document expected results, check edge cases, and validate Salesforce inputs and commission calculations against approved plan terms.
* Lead monthly and quarterly compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery.
* Partner with Finance, People, and RevOps leadership to ensure alignment with payroll, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Analyze compensation effectiveness and lead modeling efforts to optimize plan design and align incentives with business objectives.
* Identify and implement process improvements to increase scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of compensation operations.
**Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting**
* Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.
* Design and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide clear visibility into business performance.
* Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, productivity, and forecasting trends, influencing strategic decision-making.
* Lead complex data analysis initiatives, synthesizing insights across multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, BI tools).
* Partner with senior leadership to support planning cycles, QBRs, and strategic initiatives.
**AI Agents and Workflow Automation**
* Identify and prioritize RevOps workflows for agentic AI based on business impact, manual effort, data readiness, and risk. Define the expected outcome and how to measure it before building.
* Build and maintain multi-step workflows with Claude or comparable tools. Define which data sources each workflow uses, what it checks, and when it routes an exception to a person.
* Strengthen Board and executive reporting. Build workflows to reconcile metrics across Salesforce, Power BI, and Finance, flag unexplained variances, and draft commentary tied to verified figures for human review.
* Support GTM planning and analysis. Use agentic workflows to compare quota, capacity, and territory scenarios, document assumptions, and show which inputs drive the largest changes in projected bookings.
* Validate workflows before release and after changes. Test against known outcomes and edge cases, track false positives and missed exceptions, and require human approval before workflows update records or distribute sensitive reports.
* Measure results and support adoption. Track time saved, exception accuracy, and usage. Document workflows and train analysts and business partners to run them, review outputs, and troubleshoot common issues.
**GTM Systems Administration**
* Own day-to-day administration of Gong and assigned sales intelligence tools. Manage user access, permissions, licenses, team structures, and platform settings.
* Configure Gong to support weekly forecast reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching. Build and maintain views that help leaders spot deal risk, track forecast changes, and prepare for pipeline reviews.
* Configure sales intelligence tools to support account research, prospecting, and contact enrichment. Set rules for which data flows into Salesforce and how to handle duplicates or conflicting values.
* Monitor data flow between Gong, sales intelligence tools, and Salesforce. Investigate sync failures and data discrepancies. Partner with GTM Systems and vendors on integration changes and escalations.
* Lead testing and rollout of new features. Document configurations, train users, and track adoption and license usage to inform renewal and expansion decisions.
* Build agentic AI workflows that combine approved Gong and Salesforce data to flag deal risks and prepare forecast review briefs. Link findings to source records and route them to sales leaders for review.
**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or related analytical roles, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
* Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and administering production commission plans in Spiff.
* Experience owning full sales compensation cycles, including payout reconciliation, exception resolution, and approval workflows.
* Experience producing Board or executive leadership reporting, including reconciling metrics across systems and writing concise variance commentary.
* Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as Claude or comparable platforms
* Experience connecting agents to business systems, troubleshooting failures, and validating results.
* Advanced Salesforce and Excel skills and experience building or maintaining reporting in Power BI or a comparable BI platform.

This role is responsible for serving as a trusted partner to a dedicated book of business, driving adoption, engagement, and consistent revenue retention.

* Internal and External Relationship Management

* Effective Time and Portfolio Management

The CSM operates at a tactical level , bridging operational execution with strategic objectives, and ensures that customer outcomes, service reliability, and non‑functional requirements are consistently met.
The role requires strong affinity with infrastructure, hardware, and store technology environments , as well as the ability to coordinate across multiple internal and external service providers.
 Key Responsibilities
 Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as the primary tactical point of contact for customer delivery, satisfaction, and service‑related discussions.
Translate customer needs into actionable service requirements across the chain.
Build trusted relationships across customer operations, engineering, and management layers.
 Service Chain Governance
Lead or contribute to end‑to‑end chain orchestration across internal teams, vendors, and SIAM‑related roles (without focusing solely on service level management).
Ensure alignment between operational teams and customer expectations.
Drive coordination across infrastructure, hardware, and field operations streams.
 Operational Performance & Continuous Improvement
Monitor service performance, identify structural issues, and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives.
Analyse recurring incidents, trends, and non‑functionals (availability, reliability, performance).
Proactively recommend and implement service enhancements.
 Tactical Delivery Leadership
Operate above the day‑to‑day operations—focusing on mid‑term service stability, service roadmaps, and improvement plans.
Connect industry trends and best practices to internal processes and customer environments.
Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, and Product teams to ensure sustainable service delivery.
 Technical Affinity
Understand store infrastructure, hardware lifecycles, and device/service architecture sufficiently to engage in meaningful discussions with technical stakeholders.
Translate technology topics into business‑relevant outcomes for customers.
 Required Skills & Experience
Strong understanding of infrastructure services, retail hardware, and/or operational technology environments.
Experience in chain-management, service management, or SIAM concepts.
Proven ability to operate at a tactical level, not only operational.
Continuous improvement mindset, including identification and remediation of structural service issues.
Strong analytical skills with focus on non-functional requirements.
Excellent communication skills, able to navigate between technical teams and business stakeholders.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience in managed services, retail technology, or multi‑vendor service landscapes.
Familiarity with incident and problem management frameworks.
Ability to connect external industry trends to customer environments and internal processes through the lens of company’s best practice.

Overview
 The Partner Enablement Leader builds, from zero, the function that equips our partners to sell, deliver and support our products as well as our own teams do. Partners include resellers, channel and distribution, alliances, referral and implementation partners.
This is a leader-of-leaders role and a true 0-to-1 build. There is no existing playbook, team or operating model to inherit. You will define the strategy, hire the managers and enablers who execute it, and scale the function globally.
You will work across Sales, Partnerships, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal and Finance, each with its own priorities. The role reports to the Director of Sales Enablement.
 Responsibilities
 What you'll do
 Build the function from zero
Define the partner enablement vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned to partner revenue and go-to-market goals.
Segment partners by type, tier and maturity, and design differentiated enablement journeys for each.
Build the core programs: onboarding, certification and accreditation, sales and technical training, co-selling playbooks, and ongoing readiness.
Stand up the operating model, including intake and prioritization, governance, content standards, tooling and a partner learning platform.
 Hire, build and scale the team
Recruit, onboard and develop a team of managers and enablement professionals across regions, many of whom will lead their own teams as the function grows.
Set the structure, career paths, hiring bar and performance standards for a new team.
Build a culture of ownership, rigor and fast iteration, and coach managers to lead and develop their own teams.
Scale across geographies and languages, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
 Lead complex stakeholder management
Partner with the leaders of Sales, Channel and Alliances, Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Legal to align on priorities and resolve conflicts.
Earn buy-in and secure funding and headcount in an environment where enablement for partners competes with other investments.
Engage directly with strategic partners and their leadership to understand readiness gaps and shape programs.
Communicate progress, results and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders.
 Drive an AI-forward enablement model
Use AI to personalize learning paths, generate and localize content, coach partner sellers, and answer partner questions at scale.
Build AI-enabled workflows that raise team productivity, such as faster content creation, intelligent search and automated readiness tracking.
Evaluate new AI tools with a clear view of value, risk, data privacy and adoption, and set standards for responsible use.
Make your team fluent in AI, and model that fluency in how you work.
 Measure and prove impact
Define metrics that link enablement to partner outcomes: time to first deal, certified-partner revenue, win rates, pipeline contribution, attach and retention.
Run a regular business review with leadership, and adjust programs based on what the data shows.
First 12 months
In the first year, you will go from a blank page to a functioning, measured partner enablement program with a core team in place.
Days 1 to 30: launch and hire. Ship the first onboarding and certification program for the highest-priority partner segment. Hire the first managers and key enablers. Establish baseline metrics.
Days 30-180: scale and prove. Launch the program to over 200 partners. Select a tech stack, and generate revenue. At 6 months you will Extend programs to additional segments and regions. Introduce AI-enabled learning and coaching. Report the first business-impact results and set the plan for year two.
 Qualifications
 Required qualifications
12 or more years of experience in enablement, channel or partner programs, sales operations, or a related go-to-market function, with at least 5 years leading teams.
Proven experience managing managers, including hiring, developing and holding them accountable for results.
A record of building a new function, program or team from zero to one, including defining strategy, structure and operating rhythm without an existing playbook.
Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders across functions without direct authority, and navigating competing priorities.
Hands-on experience designing and running enablement at scale, such as onboarding, certification, training and readiness programs.
Working knowledge of how partner and channel businesses operate, including partner tiers, incentives, co-selling and partner lifecycle.
Practical experience using AI to improve how work gets done, and a clear point of view on where it creates value in enablement.
Strong analytical skills, with experience tying enablement to business metrics.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives.
Experience leading distributed, global teams.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience launching a partner enablement or partner academy program in a technology, SaaS or financial services company.
Experience building and operating a partner learning platform or partner portal.
Experience building or deploying AI-powered tools for learning, coaching or knowledge management.
Experience in a high-growth or turnaround environment where structure was built while the business was moving.
Experience enabling both direct and indirect sales motions and working with strategic partners and system integrators.
Familiarity with global markets, multiple languages and regional partner ecosystems.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree a plus.

AWS provides industry-leading services and solutions for video games, including multi-player game hosting and cloud streaming at global scale. We help developers, studios, and publishers build, scale, and deliver exceptional gaming experiences worldwide. Our technology powers some of the world’s biggest games.
As a Principal Worldwide Visual Computing GTM Specialist for GameTech, you own global go-to-market strategy for AWS GameTech services in the UK and EMEA, as well as the end-to-end sales cycle in your geography. You will identify and develop relationships with high-potential customers, gather requirements to influence product roadmaps, and drive adoption of GameTech services across gaming and adjacent industries.

 Develop and execute strategic GTM initiatives across AWS groups and international stakeholders.
 Develop strategic relationships with game developers, studios, publishers, and partners to drive adoption of AWS Game Tech services and related AWS products.
 Educate customers and industry organizations on AWS Game Tech solutions, leveraging AWS go-to-market programs to accelerate growth.
 Apply expert judgment to distill diverse inputs and design long-term solutions at scale.

Since 2012, Rightsline has been making work easier for rights and royalties professionals with our innovative rights and royalties management software, allowing our customers to maximize their portfolios without having to max out their daily to-do-lists.
Our fully integrated and configurable platform provides customers with comprehensive access to all their rights and royalties, across all markets and platforms, instantly. Departments can communicate, collaborate, and cohesively take action without worrying about mistakes; and in-app reports and timely alerts ensure our customers never miss an opportunity to do more.
The Position
The Sr. RevOps Analyst drives top-of-funnel velocity, pipeline conversion efficiency, and day-to-day sales operational excellence. This role is responsible for monitoring funnel bottlenecks, ensuring adherence to lead routing and stage-exit criteria, administering territory and quota allocations, and providing commercial teams with actionable reporting and analytics. This role is based in the Greater Toronto Area (hybrid), reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations.
Mission & Impact
Support faster lead follow-up, healthier pipelines, and timely, actionable commercial reporting through accurate funnel analytics and disciplined sales operations. Performance is measured by lead conversion improvement, SLA adherence, clean pipeline records, and on-time forecast reporting.
What You Will OwnFunnel Analytics & Conversion Tracking
Monitor stage-by-stage pipeline velocity, tracking conversion metrics from Lead → MQL → SQL → Opportunity → Closed-Won to identify stalled pipeline and process friction.
Inbound & Outbound SLA Enforcement
Oversee lead routing performance and audit sales response times against agreed SLAs, ensuring rapid follow-up on high-value inbound leads.
Territory & Quota Administration
Support the annual and mid-year territory carving processes, manage account assignment balance, maintain quota files, and calculate monthly attainment metrics.
Pipeline Hygiene & Deal Inspection
Audit pipeline records for compliance with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC), stage exit criteria, close-date validity, and next-step documentation.
Commercial Reporting & Dashboards
Build and maintain operational dashboards for Sales and Marketing leadership, providing daily and weekly visibility into pacing, coverage ratios, and campaign ROI.
Marketing Collaboration & Attribution
Partner with Marketing to assess campaign performance, lead scoring thresholds, campaign hierarchy tracking, and lead-to-revenue attribution.
Key Deliverables & Performance KPIs
Lead-to-Opportunity Conversion Lift
SLA Adherence: >95% of qualified leads contacted within target SLA windows.
Pipeline Hygiene Index: Zero overdue opportunities or missing close dates at month-end.
Forecast Cadence Readiness: Weekly forecast decks and pacing reports delivered on schedule.
Technical Boundary & Clean Handoff
Primary Boundary: Interfaces directly with field sellers, SDRs, and marketing campaign managers to analyze process bottlenecks. Translates field operational issues into requirements for schema modifications or automated pipeline enrichment.
What You Will Bring
2 to 4 years of analytical experience in Operations, Marketing Operations, or Revenue Operations in B2B SaaS.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (complex formulas, index/match, pivot tables) and BI reporting tools.
Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboard building; familiarity with ZoomInfo and Clay workflows.
Strong quantitative problem-solving ability with clear written and verbal communication skills.
Our Core Values
At Rightsline, we look for these qualities in every hire, and we hold ourselves to them every day.
Be Curious and Smart
Being smart isn't about having all the answers — it's about asking the right questions, seeking out new ideas, and never assuming you already know enough.
Embrace Change
This industry moves fast and so do we. We don't resist change — we lean into it. That means staying flexible, letting go of what isn't working, and treating uncertainty as opportunity rather than obstacle.
Show Up
Showing up means being present — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally. Your teammates count on you. Your customers count on you. We do our best work when everyone is fully engaged and accountable to each other.
Get it Done
Ideas are easy. Execution is the job. We hold ourselves to what we commit to, push through the hard parts, and measure success by our actual accomplishments.
Be Humble
Nobody here has a monopoly on good ideas. We listen more than we talk, share credit freely, and check our egos at the door. The best outcome matters more than whose idea it was.

Rightsline is an equal opportunity workplace. All candidates will be afforded equal opportunity through the recruiting process. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity and/or expression. We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented individuals and creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.
If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

If you want to join a company that strives for a mission, purpose and making an impact, we encourage you to apply today.

The Company 
 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.
When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.
AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.
This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.
 The Role
 The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.
This role owns critical components of revenue operations, including sales compensation execution, performance analytics, and executive reporting. In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.
As a key contributor to strategic planning and revenue optimization, this individual plays a central role in enabling predictable, scalable growth while continuously evolving reporting frameworks, compensation programs, and operational processes.
 What You Do
 Sales Compensation Ownership & Strategy
Own the build and end-to-end administration of sales compensation programs, including plan implementation, maintenance, and commission calculations.
Test new plans and changes before release. Document expected results, check edge cases, and validate Salesforce inputs and commission calculations against approved plan terms.
Lead monthly and quarterly compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery.
Partner with Finance, People, and RevOps leadership to ensure alignment with payroll, audit, and compliance requirements.
Analyze compensation effectiveness and lead modeling efforts to optimize plan design and align incentives with business objectives.
Identify and implement process improvements to increase scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of compensation operations.
 Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting
Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.
Design and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide clear visibility into business performance.
Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, productivity, and forecasting trends, influencing strategic decision-making.
Lead complex data analysis initiatives, synthesizing insights across multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, BI tools).
Partner with senior leadership to support planning cycles, QBRs, and strategic initiatives.
 AI Agents and Workflow Automation
Identify and prioritize RevOps workflows for agentic AI based on business impact, manual effort, data readiness, and risk. Define the expected outcome and how to measure it before building.
Build and maintain multi-step workflows with Claude or comparable tools. Define which data sources each workflow uses, what it checks, and when it routes an exception to a person.
Strengthen Board and executive reporting. Build workflows to reconcile metrics across Salesforce, Power BI, and Finance, flag unexplained variances, and draft commentary tied to verified figures for human review.
Support GTM planning and analysis. Use agentic workflows to compare quota, capacity, and territory scenarios, document assumptions, and show which inputs drive the largest changes in projected bookings.
Validate workflows before release and after changes. Test against known outcomes and edge cases, track false positives and missed exceptions, and require human approval before workflows update records or distribute sensitive reports.
Measure results and support adoption. Track time saved, exception accuracy, and usage. Document workflows and train analysts and business partners to run them, review outputs, and troubleshoot common issues.
 GTM Systems Administration
Own day-to-day administration of Gong and assigned sales intelligence tools. Manage user access, permissions, licenses, team structures, and platform settings.
Configure Gong to support weekly forecast reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching. Build and maintain views that help leaders spot deal risk, track forecast changes, and prepare for pipeline reviews.
Configure sales intelligence tools to support account research, prospecting, and contact enrichment. Set rules for which data flows into Salesforce and how to handle duplicates or conflicting values.
Monitor data flow between Gong, sales intelligence tools, and Salesforce. Investigate sync failures and data discrepancies. Partner with GTM Systems and vendors on integration changes and escalations.
Lead testing and rollout of new features. Document configurations, train users, and track adoption and license usage to inform renewal and expansion decisions.
Build agentic AI workflows that combine approved Gong and Salesforce data to flag deal risks and prepare forecast review briefs. Link findings to source records and route them to sales leaders for review.
 What You Bring
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or related analytical roles, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and administering production commission plans in Spiff.
Experience owning full sales compensation cycles, including payout reconciliation, exception resolution, and approval workflows.
Experience producing Board or executive leadership reporting, including reconciling metrics across systems and writing concise variance commentary.
Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as Claude or comparable platforms
Experience connecting agents to business systems, troubleshooting failures, and validating results.
Advanced Salesforce and Excel skills and experience building or maintaining reporting in Power BI or a comparable BI platform.
 Asset Qualifications
Experience with commission tools (e.g., SPIFF or similar platforms).
Proficiency in SQL or other data querying languages.
Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV) and recurring revenue models.
Experience with territory planning, quota setting, and GTM strategy.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive process improvements.

job.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.
 Your Role 
bunch is growing its sales team in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Each account executive owns a set of named accounts and reaches out when something happens at one of them, for example a new fundraise or a new CFO. You build and run the system that supports this: the data on our market of fund managers, the signals that tell an account executive when to reach out, and the preparation of outreach.
You will:
Prepare a book of accounts for every new Account Executive, with the right contacts and the CRM history.
Keep the fund managers in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany up to date in HubSpot.
Create HubSpot tasks from signals such as fundraises, regulator registrations (FCA, BaFin, CSSF), new hires in finance and operations, and contacts who change firm.
Set up a weekly account brief for each account executive and drafted messages that improve from account executive feedback.
Show account executives who at bunch already knows someone at an account to increase a partnership revenue channel.
Get recorded calls into HubSpot, and add stage rules and required fields that keep the CRM data clean.
Route inbound leads to the account executive who owns the account.
Build all of this as code that is scheduled, monitored and documented.
 About you 
3+ years building a GTM or revenue operations system end to end at a B2B company.
You understand how B2B sales teams work and like to work closely with account executives.
Deep HubSpot knowledge: custom objects, associations, workflows, the API, and where HubSpot breaks.
Daily use of Claude or similar AI tools, and a clear view of where they fail and where they can be put to use for account executives.
Knowledge of the modern data stack (ingestion, warehouse, transformation, reverse ETL, enrichment) and how it connects to the CRM.
You know which leading indicators to track, why they predict revenue, and how to make them reliable in the CRM.
 Workplace & Benefits 
Hybrid work 
28 days of paid vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays.
Up to 6 working weeks a year working remotely from abroad, subject to approval and location restrictions.
Flexible benefits budget for options including food, mobility and sport.
A great tech and work setup, and a learning and development budget after probation in line with your approved development plan
 Hiring process 
 Screening with Ivo, our Analytics Lead and Hiring Manager for the role 45 minutes).
 Case Interview | Architecture) with Ivo (30 minutes).
 Case Interview | Process with Strategy & Marketing (45 minutes).
 Final Interview with Enrico, our Co-Founder and Commercial Leader (30 minutes).
Questions? Reach out to Recruiting@bunch.capital .

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.
We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.
